title: Composition of target transitions
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring and let $q\in\mathbf Z$. Let $e:Y\to T$, $h:Y\to X$, $\pi_2:T_2\to T$, $a_2:Y_2\to Y$, $e_2:Y_2\to T_2$, $h_2:Y_2\to X$, $\pi_1:T_1\to T_2$, $a_1:Y_1\to Y_2$, $e_1:Y_1\to T_1$, and $h_1:Y_1\to X$ be morphisms of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] such that $e a_2=\pi_2e_2$, $h a_2=h_2$, $e_2a_1=\pi_1e_1$, and $h_2a_1=h_1$. For any etale sheaf $F$ of $\Lambda$-modules on $T$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], let $t_2$ and $t_1$ be the canonical restriction transitions on the degree-$q$ targets $R^qh_*e^{-1}F$ of [sbc-def-base-change-map], for $\pi_2$ and $\pi_1$, respectively. Then $t_1t_2$, followed by the target functor applied to the canonical identification $\pi_1^{-1}\pi_2^{-1}F\cong(\pi_2\pi_1)^{-1}F$, equals the target transition for $\pi_2\pi_1$ covered by $a_2a_1$. No cartesianness is required.

source.place: Proof, condition (1): thickenings; transition compatibility made explicit

proof.text: Use [lem-sbc-lower-star-plus-transition-comp] at e^*(F[0]) for the derived direct-image transition composition. Naturality of lowerStarPlusTransition is proved in Lean by expressing it as the identity pullback comparison followed by the source-library baseChange transformation, and applying its naturality to the first coefficient correction.

Use [lem-sbc-pullback-comparison-comp] to combine the coefficient corrections. The private transition_with_coefficients_comp lemma moves the first correction through the second transition, combines the final direct-image functor maps, substitutes coefficient coherence, and applies the direct-image composition equality. Apply degree-q homology using map_comp_three.

proof_origin.place: condition (1): the two coefficient and transition composition steps, combined by naturality and functoriality in Lean
